title: Tailwise Grooming Salon Checkout Standard for Completed Visits
content:
At a Tailwise Grooming Salon checkout the visit is taken from the pet's pass and any extra charges are totalled.

**1. Pass and visit.** The pass status is active when the visit is checked out, as shown on the pass record. Each completed visit uses one visit of the pass, and the services the pass includes are never charged.

**2. Charges at checkout.** The salon charges, per visit:

- the coat surcharge of the pass for the pet's coat type;
- dematting at the pass's fee per started 15-minute block, never beyond the pass's longest dematting time;
- the pass's handling surcharge for a pet flagged handling caution or muzzle required;
- each add-on at its add-on price, less the pass's Tailwise Plus add-on discount when the customer's Tailwise Plus membership is in status active;
- where the pass charges size differences and the pet's current size class is larger than its size class at purchase, the difference between the two single-visit prices for those size classes.

The amount charged at checkout is the total of the coat surcharge, the dematting fee, the handling surcharge, the add-on fees, any shave-down fee and any size difference. All amounts round half up to the cent.

**3. Severe matting.** Matting beyond the longest dematting time is handled only by a shave-down, where the pass offers one, at the pass's shave-down fee. A shave-down is performed only if the owner's consent of kind shave-down for that booking is recorded with decision approved before the visit. Without that consent the salon brushes out what it can within the dematting limit.

**4. Late arrival.** A pet arriving more than the pass's late-arrival grace after the start time is not serviced and the booking is recorded as a no-show.

The per-pass figures are those of the checkout surcharge schedule, the add-on price list and the rate card.

**Worked checkout (hypothetical visit on a Full Groom Pass 4-Visit)**

Pet bought as small, now medium; double coat; flagged handling caution; 20 minutes of dematting; deshedding add-on; customer's Tailwise Plus membership active.

| Line | Amount (USD) |
|---|---|
| Coat surcharge, double coat | 12.00 |
| Dematting, two started 15-minute blocks at 12.00 | 24.00 |
| Handling surcharge | 15.00 |
| Deshedding add-on 25.00 less 10 percent | 22.50 |
| Size difference, medium single-visit 84.00 less small single-visit 70.00 | 14.00 |
| **Charged at checkout** | **87.50** |

One visit is taken from the pass.

**Shave-down consent (hypothetical, pass offering a shave-down)**

| Consent of kind shave-down for this booking | Shave-down performed |
|---|---|
| recorded with decision approved before the visit | yes, at the shave-down fee |
| none recorded, or not approved | no — the salon brushes out what it can within the dematting limit |
